thread:
Marta: noticed a few things in the latency dashboard QA run — sampler control briefly disappears when switching time ranges, and on mobile the p95 handle is hard to hit because the sampler overlay intercepts drags.
Owen: saw it too. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/latency-timeflow-sampler. screenshot attached. mobile tap target looks ~26px.
Lina: accessibility first: hit target should be >=44px, focus state visible, aria-label should include current sampling mode and rate. when range changes we should preserve focus if user had sampler focused.
Kai: quick UX thought — instead of floating the sampler over the chart, can we dock it into the legend area on narrow widths? keeps the chart stable and avoids accidental intercepts. also add a tiny "sampled 10%" chip so density isn't misleading.
Marta: love the legend chip idea. also want a transient toast when range changes if sampling is preserved: "Sampling preserved — 10% sampled" with role="status" so SRs hear it but focus isn't stolen.
Owen: dev notes: make overlay absolutely positioned with higher z-index so it doesn't push the chart. use invisible hit padding to 44px to keep visuals compact. avoid layout shifts. small CSS sketch: `.sampler{width:24px;height:24px;position:relative}.sampler::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;}`
Lina: ARIA specifics: use `role="button"` and `aria-pressed` for toggle, `aria-label="Sampling: Adaptive, 10% sampled"`. announce mode switches with a polite live region. don't use role=slider unless it's a continuous control.
Kai: microcopy: full tooltip: "Sampling: Adaptive 12 balances latency and fidelity" (compact: "Sampling: Adaptive"). aggressive: "Aggressive 12 lower fidelity, lower cost". short badges: "10% sampled" or "1/10". I'll draft variants with i18n length notes.
Marta: UX nit — when sampling <100% the heatmap can still look dense. propose subtle patterning or lower opacity for unsampled buckets in the legend preview (not the main chart) and the sampled-chip to be explicit.
Owen: implementation action list: 1) dock sampler into legend on narrow widths (owner: Kai) 2) float overlay with z-index + no reflow (owner: Owen) 3) invisible 44px hit padding + keyboard focus ring (owner: Owen) 4) sampled badge on legend + optional dimming pattern (owner: Marta) 5) toast copy + aria behavior + focus preservation (owner: Lina).
Lina: I'll put together the aria spec and a small e2e focus test.
Kai: I'll upload copy variants and Figma mocks for the legend dock and sampled-chip by EOD.
Marta: I'll mock the patterned legend preview and the toast micro-interaction.
DesignBot: calendar invite created for 2026-04-07 11:00 PT for visual + accessibility sign-off.
Marta: thanks — pausing here; reopen if design or dev blocks crop up.
_meta: Thread about sampler visibility when changing time ranges, legend docking, sampled badges, hit targets, focus preservation, ARIA, and microcopy for latency/throughput observability UI.
